sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Chapter Six How to pass

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A01
Left passing is the default barred by seven conditions while right passing is the exception allowed by three, a default-versus-exception pair [A01].
Why it matters: group passing; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F05, sec06-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=39]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A01
Entry checks the left shoulder while return checks the mirror plus the right shoulder and pavement, two different glance scripts for two different moves [A01].
Why it matters: group procedure; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=39]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A02
Yellow bus flashers only slow and ready the driver while red flashers halt both directions twenty feet back until release, warning versus command [A02].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F09, sec06-F11, sec06-F12 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=40]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A02
Driver convictions fine up to one thousand with license revocation on repeats while camera tickets bill owners on a lower ladder, two punishment tracks for one offense [A02].
Why it matters: group penalties; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F15, sec06-F16 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=40]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A01
Motorcycles demand a full untouched lane while bicycles demand a safe left berth, absolute space versus judged space [A01].
Why it matters: group vulnerable-users; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F02, sec06-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=39]
